conventions.semantics: OSIL decimals read as exact rationals (reading (b)); exact feasibility without tolerance
conventions.displays: dual bounds rounded down (up for maximisation), primal values rounded up (down for maximisation), gaps rounded up, at-least margins and factors rounded down; never to nearest
conventions.abs_gap: Delta = s(U - L) from the exact certificate ends; 3 significant digits, rounded up
conventions.rel_gap: delta = Delta/min(|L|,|U|); 3 significant digits rounded up; percent cells two decimals (three significant digits below 1%) rounded up
conventions.listed: best single-solver dual bound on the instance page; best point with listed violation <= 1e-8
